Heard Mr. Abhishek Ranjan, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner and Mr. Arun Kumar, learned APP appearing on behalf of the State.
2. The petitioner seeks pre-arrest bail in connection with Complaint Case No.C-2788 of 2022 (Trial No.1455 of 2024) registered for the offence(s) punishable under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code.
3. At the outset, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner submits that the matter be referred to the Mediation Center.

4. The matter is referred to the Mediation and Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.64685 of 2024(2)
dt.05-10-2024 Conciliation Center of Patna High Court, Patna for amicable settlement of matrimonial dispute between the parties.
